 Carter & Smith Injury Lawyers

Claims Department
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Re: Claim C-1295 - Demand for settlement
Dear Claims Representative:
Our office represents Dylan Thomas in connection with the motor vehicle collision that occurred on 6-10-23. Our
client was lawfully traveling in their lane when your insured's vehicle crossed the centerline and struck our client's car
head-on. Although the impact occurred at a low rate of speed, the force of the collision was suffiicent to cause
significant soft tissue injuries, including a cervical strain and a lumbar strain. Our client sought prompt medical
evaluation at the scene and has since completed a course of physical therapy and follow-up care. Treating providers
have documented restricted range of motion, muscle spasm, and ongoing pain that interferes with daily activities,
work duties, and sleep.
Liability is clear. The police report and the physical evidence support the conclusion that your insured failed to keep a
proper lookout and to remain within their own lane of travel. There is no reasonable basis to dispute fault.
Our client's damages include past and future medical expenses, lost wages, and the pain and suffering caused by
these injuries. Taking all of these losses into account, we are authorized to resolve this claim for $98,000.00. This
demand will remain open for thirty days from the date of this letter. If we do not receive a satisfactory response within
that period, we will file suit without further notice and seek all damages available under law.
Expert review: Jeffrey Lawrence, orthopedic surgeon
Sincerely,
Carlos Fox
Carter & Smith Injury Lawyers
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
